finish_official_texture photographic mode preserves highresolution natural forms using only smooth reduced-colour correction and optional explicit measured landmarks. It is not a universal seam or wronggeometry repair. Reuse unchanged only when needed; reject/regenerate wrong forms rather than imprint native pixel/noise boundaries.

encode_official_maps enforces4x input, refuses overwrites, encodes diffuse/height/independentXYZ grayscale WebPs at lossy92, and builds normals from decoded92 scalarheight. This existing route is reusable unchanged. Relief strength must be chosen by material/visual inspection, not copied as a universal embossed surface.
